page_title: BOU 0-0 CRY | Bournemouth v Crystal Palace 26/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) jumps into a tackle and Thomas Bramall signals a foul.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) replaces Eberechi Eze.
85' Andoni Iraola has decided to make a change. David Brooks (Bournemouth) replaces Dango Ouattara.
85' Trevoh Chalobah (Crystal Palace) receives the ball and has a go from distance, but he shouldn't have bothered as it sails high over the bar.
84' Philip Billing (Bournemouth) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Thomas Bramall blows his whistle for a foul.
82' Substitution. Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) replaces Jean-Philippe Mateta.
80' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
79' Philip Billing (Bournemouth) latches on to a precise cross on the edge of the box and strikes the ball goalwards. However, it whistles wide of the right post so the goalkeeper can relax.
78' The corner kick from Philip Billing (Bournemouth) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
76' Thomas Bramall blows his whistle after Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
74' Fine attempt! Evanilson (Bournemouth) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.
73' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) gets on the end of a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but it's a poor header and drifts high over the bar.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Justin Kluivert leaves the pitch and Philip Billing (Bournemouth) comes on.
71' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post.
69' The expression of the referee Thomas Bramall is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Dean Huijsen (Bournemouth) is shown a yellow card.
67' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
66' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
64' Evanilson (Bournemouth) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom right corner, but Dean Henderson is equal to it and makes an easy save.
62' Substitution. Enes Unal did his best and is replaced by Evanilson (Bournemouth).
62' Andoni Iraola prepares a substitution. Maximillian Aarons is replaced by Tyler Adams (Bournemouth).
60' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) sees a yellow card from Thomas Bramall after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
56' 4:1 – the corner kicks stats.
53' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) is caught offside!
53' Problems for Oliver Glasner as Will Hughes is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Cheick Doucoure (Crystal Palace) replaces him.
52' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) picks up an injury.
51' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) tries to put the rebound into the net from the edge of the box, but the goalkeeper pulls off a good save to deny him.
51' Bournemouth can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

49' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) latches onto a pass and lets rip with a swerving shot from long range towards the bottom left corner. It's a difficult effort to deal with and Kepa Arrizabalaga does well to punch it away.
49' The corner is swung in but Crystal Palace can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

48' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. Corner kick. Crystal Palace will have an opportunity.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Thomas Bramall has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
42' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) commits a rough foul. Thomas Bramall stops the game and makes a call.
39' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) commits a foul and Thomas Bramall immediately signals a free kick.
35' The ratio of the ball possession is 46:54.
33' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) covers his face with his hands after wasting a promising chance. He takes the rebound on the edge of the box but blazes the ball high over the crossbar.
33' There's an opportunity for Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
31' Enes Unal (Bournemouth) slams the ball from a long-range free kick. He should have curled it higher to avoid hitting the wall.
30' Poor challenge! Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) is penalised for tripping and Thomas Bramall blows his whistle.
29' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
27' A goal, which was scored by Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace), was disallowed due to offside.
23' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
23' The referee blows his whistle, Bournemouth are awarded a corner kick.
22' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) receives a short pass and produces a low effort from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and makes a routine save.
21' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
18' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) is penalised for holding. Thomas Bramall signals a set piece.

16' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) has a lack of options after running onto a pass, so shoots from long range. It's a decent effort towards the bottom right corner, but Dean Henderson pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
15' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
15' The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth have been awarded a corner kick.

12' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Kepa Arrizabalaga pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
10' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
9' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace).
8' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
7' A yellow card for a tackle by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace). Thomas Bramall doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
7' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
4' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) gets a yellow card. The referee Thomas Bramall made the right call.
